Animal · SM -1 Monitor Lizard [Monster Manual, page 275]

A heavy ochre-brown lizard the size of a large dog, bow-legged, with a flicking forked tongue and a long muscular tail it uses like a club. It tastes the air to track carrion or prey, digs, climbs, swims, and eats considerably more than seems reasonable.
